messages:
ops_bot: ALERT: Canary rollout 'text-gen-canary' has 5xx rate spike (from 0.3% -> 4.8%) and latency regression. Auto-rollback triggered but reports indicate 18% traffic still routing to canary. Pager sent.

matt_oncall: On it, acked pager :phone:. Starting investigation — grabbing status and routing.

jessie_sre: I see partial rollback in controller logs: `rollback task started` succeeded, but traffic-split shows mesh policy still has pinned routes for some clients. Likely stale feature-flag/edge-cache.

sara_eng: Confirming — feature flag `use_new_model_v2` is still on for a subset of traffic (region: eu-west-1). That explains pinned sessions.

matt_oncall: Good catch. Lia, any customer impact notes?

lia_pm: Customer Ops reporting increased error rate for two enterprise customers; CS taking initial outreach. No major support tickets yet, but SLA alerts fired. @customer_success please confirm.

customer_success: Confirmed: Customer A seeing intermittent 500s on chat endpoints since 12:03 UTC. They've throttled retries but are asking for ETA. Keeping them updated.

matt_oncall: Plan: 1) Force manual rollback to v1.9 across all data planes 2) Toggle flag `use_new_model_v2` -> false globally 3) Evict per-session routing / clear edge sticky routing 4) Run smoke tests and sanity prompts

jessie_sre: I'm running the manual rollback now. Command:```bash
# rollback control plane
redwoodctl rollout rollback --deployment text-gen --to-version v1.9 --force --namespace=prod
# ensure canary replicas scaled to 0
kubectl scale deploy/text-gen-canary --replicas=0 -n prod
```

sara_eng: Toggling flag in FF service now: `ffctl set use_new_model_v2 false --scope=global --reason="emergency rollback"`

deploy_bot: deploy-bot: rollback job started (job id: rb-20260317-0945). Health-check stream attached.

jessie_sre: Rolling back completed on control plane, but mesh still shows ~12% sticky sessions to canary for eu-west-1. Running cache eviction and session rebind script.```bash
# evict sticky routing
redwoodctl mesh evict-sessions --label region=eu-west-1 --deployment text-gen
# flush prefix KV cache
redwoodctl cache flush --prefix="kv:prompt_cache" --region=eu-west-1
```

matt_oncall: Running quick verification queries against the API to ensure v1.9 responses and no 5xx. Example tests:```bash
curl -sS -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -d '{"model":"text-gen","prompt":"Hello"}' | jq '.status'
# expect 200
```

lia_pm: CS updated customers: ETA ~15m while we clear sticky sessions, offered status updates and ticket priority bump.

customer_success: Customers acknowledged and appreciate proactive updates. Monitoring their side; no escalations yet.

jessie_sre: Post-evict: metrics show 0.2% 5xx, latency back to baseline. Canary pods are scaled to 0 and traffic table shows 100% to v1.9 across regions.

sara_eng: Smoke tests pass for 10/10 scripted prompts across regions (us/uk/eu). Running quality quick-check with eval harness now.

matt_oncall: Good. I'll keep this thread open until postmortem ticket is created. Immediate mitigation complete. Next steps: - create incident ticket with timeline - add root cause hypothesis: stale FF + session pinning prevented full auto-rollback - consider automated mesh invalidation on rollback path - schedule retro with SRE/infra/dev in 24h

lia_pm: I'll draft customer communication for tomorrow with timeline and actions.

deploy_bot: deploy-bot: rollback job rb-20260317-0945 marked SUCCESS at 3175000540.

jessie_sre: Final check: running canary smoke one more time, verifying no residual 500s in logs.

matt_oncall: Resolving now. If nothing pops in next 30m we'll close incident. Thanks all for fast coordination. :heart:

customer_success: Customers confirmed recovery on their side. Closing loop with them.

ops_bot: INCIDENT RESOLVED: Partial-rollback + sticky routing cleared. Root cause flagged for postmortem.

matt_oncall: Filed postmortem: PM-INC-2026-03-17-text-gen-partial-rollback. Assigning owners: jessie_sre (technical), sara_eng (deployment), lia_pm (customer comms).

lia_pm: Adding follow-ups: 1) Ensure rollback runbook includes mesh eviction step 2) Evaluate adding a rollback preflight that verifies no active sticky sessions 3) Add alert for feature-flag drift during rollouts.
